card.title: IPhone 14 Pro Max – No Modem Firmware After RF Layer Swap

source.title: IPhone 14 Pro Max – No Modem Firmware After RF Layer Swap

symptoms: modem firmware missing after RF board swap

claims.statement: After swapping the RF (bottom) layer on an iPhone 14 Pro, modem firmware can disappear because the donor layer's Board ID, Platform ID and SKU ID configuration resistors don't match the original.
Transfer the config resistors from the original RF board to the donor to restore modem firmware.

procedure: Confirm modem firmware blank and RF layer swapped.
Compare Board/SKU/Platform ID resistors using boardview.
Move the original resistors to the donor layer.
Check modem firmware, IMEI and signal.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
